question: Do direct multi-horizon ML forecasts improve weekly wireless phone complaint count forecasts and their uncertainty estimates?
scope: issue_type='Phone' AND method in ('Wireless (cell phone/other mobile device)', 'Wireless')
target: All submitted wireless phone complaint tickets, including Unwanted Calls; Monday-Sunday weekly counts by documented ticket_created submission timestamp in UTC
probabilistic_metric: 80% central interval score, empirical coverage and width
hypothesis: ML can improve point accuracy over simple baselines; interval adequacy is a separate empirical question
bootstrap: 2000 paired circular moving-block resamples of 3 consecutive four-week origin blocks; conditional on frozen forecasts
sensitivity: Repeat the frozen pipeline excluding issue='Unwanted Calls'; retain primary development selection
constraints: No future target enters training or interval estimation
Final evaluation does not select hyperparameters
Current snapshot historical backtest, not vintage-real-time evaluation
No subscriber denominator, causal or carrier-performance claims
